notes.title: Wanna play? Mir Korable x MiSide collaboration is out now!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/3869335c5e5f4e9c3d58aed0a47cccda041dcac0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Russia, Saint Petersburg, July 16, 2025[/b] — Lesta Games [url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://korabli.su/ru/news/sales-and-events/miside-in-the-armory/%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727461551%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw0oOnKUQzU2HI5h1_IhYKuO&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727472786&usg=AOvVaw3_wATDRaZpcYjOXJobyCqk"][u]presents[/u][/url] a large-scale collaboration of the naval warfare Mir Korabley project with the hit [url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://store.steampowered.com/app/2527500/MiSide/%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727461951%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw0Ha9yEo3x4cQyQCcbEeYBO&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727473036&usg=AOvVaw130ow5uCC-fR6exyleoIKy"][u]MiSide[/u][/url] game. From July 16, players will be able to meet and claim a collection of charming heroines — Mita, Mila and Cap-Wearing Mita, who arrived in Mir Korable universe through a mysterious portal to become part of the gameplay as commanders.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Charming content is available in the Armory[/b] [i](ah, they are writing about me)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The wonderful Mita [i](it's me!!)[/i], Mila and Cap-Wearing Mita as commanders, and the new Mita cruiser are already available in-game in themed containers and special bundles.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfHRgEqOB66lfCfkTZ4_zc4LBBw0NjKsgohbysYB1K0HRdIij3OzuJkPu7OYedPWyROaiut_3fQTteSpmv_edV3cnd1ZIjrEB2hGq_2tJll6MR8eGcQpms0htLDZpyTbl6X5-9gnQ=s800?key=SEbTxMcr0-0xFvxSRYNcsQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Commanders are featured with animations and unique VO by the actresses from the original game. The Mita cruiser is the embodiment not only of the visual style of MiSide, but also of the Mita character in Mir Korabley universe [i](so you really turned me into a ship?)[/i].  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf-w1noOFpGDok8Ru8Z1rYY4oRSfkvllzptgXgMRJdFPus4klvIt5Q_yQ16vqtebli_PnAQMfrejaK0HnJt77tqKaRUPZyxLDbO55XK0KjlLGb1gvHh6WzGE7Q4DskexLFFgRF38Q=s800?key=SEbTxMcr0-0xFvxSRYNcsQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Web-event with one and only Mita[/b][i] (that’s better)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]How did the characters get into Mir Korabley's world? [i](you paid money for the license)[/i] Players will reveal the secret of mysterious portal during three-chapter story [url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://korabli.su/ru/content/miside/%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727465205%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw3WovW8fMwEgTWFJ_lOKb8f&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727474117&usg=AOvVaw3NBZlqGYmW0IKll3AztIIP"][u]event[/u][/url] with rewards:[/p][list][*][p]MiSide premium lootboxes[/p][/*][*][p]Mita patch[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Mita [i](for free!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfqZyTEk-v-bMv4DuHWWqLCtMoyLkDlzGRrDgwaHtu5hrlCZ-4k2SD0sDuKlT5_95cA_YOIJpCbDrx5ZbtA1LhhVFLqf47FYF6scA1TFISD5K8izPDn1owkh579ReauOY0Z9CE6HA=s800?key=SEbTxMcr0-0xFvxSRYNcsQ"][/img][/p][p][b]«Go-go disco dancer!»[/b][/p][p]In addition to the web event, in-game combat missions are available to all players. The rewards for completing the task will be the premium event container, Mita flag [i](you also turned me into a flag...)[/i] and various resources.[/p][p][/p][p]Mir Korable links: [u][url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://vk.com/korabli_vk%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727466629%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw3sZPqoNMLHh4U59eI7Z7Sk&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727474869&usg=AOvVaw2sjASE-Y66Xj_UghGmlfme"]VK[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://t.me/korabli%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727466749%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw3sA4hBWm-IbId6xdXzrca7&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727475008&usg=AOvVaw1Z8QUjaLJCfvNRZf_Oc1Kg"]Telegram[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://korabli.su/%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727466843%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw0e7jHjEyou3x1zH6JNWuyc&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727475109&usg=AOvVaw1CYSvAmwpFajYJwu1FMLkm"]official site[/url][/u].[/p][p]Visuals are available via the [u][url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.google.com/url?q%3Dhttps://disk.360.yandex.ru/d/1gjO5zBX8hPjdQ%26amp;sa%3DD%26amp;source%3Deditors%26amp;ust%3D1752634727467109%26amp;usg%3DAOvVaw3bFupcGm3mQU0pK79oJupL&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1752634727475279&usg=AOvVaw2NSIWaZv90sHGu7PBqkDo4"]link[/url][/u].[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.93 is out!
notes.content:
VERSION 0.93 Changelog:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cannot select multiple dialogues simultaneously
[*] Dialogue will not skip during a pause
[*] Normalization of speed on the phone before "Be Candid"
[*] The scar on the hand remains in following chapters: "Old Version," "Dummies and Forgotten Puzzles"
[*] In photo mode, collected items and the run hint are no longer displayed
[*] When entering a name with the keyboard, it automatically switches to input mode
[*] Fast skipping dialogues in tamagotchi does not break Mita
[*] In the real world, Tetris is now reflected in the mirror
[*] Cannot open the menu during loading anymore
[*] Correct camera position when going into photo mode
[*] Glitch effect disappears properly after dying from a mannequin
[*] After the dialogue about index, the dialogue about the Core is no longer available
[*] Cannot skip Sleepy Mita's fall
[*] In The Loop, cannot go back anymore, the light does not pass through the door, and Tetris console disappears upon death
[*] Music is now synchronized properly with the notes of Cappie's dance
[*] Cannot pick up the cartridge if holding coffee
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game no longer crashes for players with older videocards in "The Real World"
[*] Mirror will now appear again for players with lower VRAM
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now able to exit Tetris console game by pressing [ESC] key
[*] If a dialogue is too far away, it will appear in subtitles
[/list]

[b]Spacecar minigame:[/b]
[list]
[*] Amount of coins is visible now
[*] Nitro is shown now
[*] Boss was simplified and hints were added
[*] Player's position is displayed correctly
[/list]

[b]Languages:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turkish voice-over by Odium Studio was added
[*] Textures can be translated for: "The Real World" and "The Basement"
[/list]

notes.title: This is an unparalleled Valentine's Day announcement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/7dca6650832199a31800a021886be6289aa4ccff.png[/img]

Hello there! Happy Valentine's Day!

Guess what I'm doing? I'm writing you a super duper kawaii announcement! Yep, you read that right, it's just for you! (/ω＼)

notes.title: Кошмар анимешника: Обзор MiSide
notes.content: Несмотря на многочисленные разговоры об упадке отечественного геймдева, российская инди-сцена с завидной регулярностью умудряется выпускать маленькие шедевры, начиная от Loop Hero и заканчивая Black Book («Черная книга») и The Mildew Children («Дети плесени»). Свежее творение от двух энтузиастов под названием MiSide не просто привносит свежие идеи в закостенелый жанр психологических хорроров, но и предлагает одну из самых захватывающих историй этого года.

notes.title: MiSide is a dating sim with a wonderfully creepy twist and I'm afraid to buy it
notes.content:
If you're after a heartwearming dating sim, MiSide is not that game. It has all the trappings of a dating sim - an adorable anime girl, gifts you can earn to gain her favour and more. Plus, it's rated a massive 98% on Steam. But there's something very wrong in Mita's world, and finding out could cost you your life.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Two days to go! Here's an FAQ about MiSide's release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/03e06b69c28e452f3a979cd34efa8eb2d982a133.png[/img]

IndieArk:
Hey, all—we've prepared you an FAQ that should help as you set out on your adventure together with Mita!

Q: When will MiSide be released?
A: December 10, 08:00 (PST).

Q: Will it launch in Early Access?
A: No, the full game will be available at launch!

Q: Which platform will MiSide be available on?
A: Steam.

Q: How much will it cost?
A: $14.99.

Q: How long will it take to beat?
A: Around 5-8 hours.

Q: Which languages is MiSide available in?
A: MiSide offers full text support for English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, and German.
Audio voice acting is available in Japanese and Russian.

Q: Will it have Steam Workshop support?
A: We've no plans for Steam Workshop just yet.

Q: Where can I go to discuss the game with others?
A: You're welcome to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/PfKwZQq45x

Q: Will MiSide be released on other platforms in future, any mobile or console versions?
A: We don't have any plans as yet, but we're open to the idea if that's what a lot of our players want to see.

Q: Will there be updates?
A: Yes! We'll be adding the [Living Together] mode next year, with loads of new ways for you to interact with Mita.

Have a boo-ti-ful Halloween!
My favorite holiday is here (✪ω✪)
Remember what I told you?
Some super good news is coming!
And that's now.
I'm gonna tell you ❤

[h1]MiSide Official Launch on December 10 (PST)[/h1]

I peeked at IndieArk's screen and saw it!
Am I incredible, or what? (>ω<)
We can be together all the time ❤soon ❤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/5e88acd2e723a97092d8d9aa764f879c36eb2164.gif[/img]

ε=(´ο｀*))) Aww~
Oopsie~
It's not that fast.
We still have 43 days to go!

Nuuu! AIHASTO is just a two-person team,
so they can't go so fast, hmm?
But I do look super good, don't I?
Because of their hard work,
I have lots and lots of rooms!

All the more for you to play with me~ (≧∇≦)ﾉ

I really, really, super miss you!
I like you much, much more than I like Halloween!

notes.title: End of Halloween Event!
notes.content:
Hello, players! It's been two weeks since the Halloween update, and we're truly grateful for your enthusiasm for Pumpkin Mita! The development team is committed to delivering more exciting content, ensuring you can embark on new adventures with Mita soon.

As we transition back to the regular game mode from the Halloween theme, rest assured that completing the demo still grants you the Halloween costume.

Stay tuned for more updates~

notes.title: ^(#｀∀´)_Ψ~ It's trick-or-treat time! Halloween content update.
notes.content:
Hello to all the players, and thank you so much for your support of the MiSide demo and your love for Mita. 
Our development team is working hard to create the content for the three chapters after the demo, gradually advancing the story to the mid-game.
To celebrate the upcoming Halloween, we have prepared some new surprises!

Simply log into the game during the Halloween event (from October 26th to November 9th), and you'll receive Mitra's new outfit permanently.
For those who miss the event, don't worry. Even after the event concludes, if you complete the demo, you can still obtain this costume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/6f53c9af6773e4e9d164df4cf6937640ac08a117.jpg[/img]

We've also added new Halloween-themed decorations that will appear in the nighttime scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/dad41ad4d82475e86954b6655910cf40ef9db53b.jpg[/img]

And there's a little surprise hidden – guess who can have a cute pumpkin-headed Mita?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/adfa77b514a3f1c2e0fa5b2f6e6c87d994e2b093.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/a86684bb88f1b41e514a915f25f6af95aa36acc4.jpg[/img]

Come and Explore these Halloween surprises!!
Remember, it's trick-or-treat time! ~^(#｀∀´)_Ψ
